statement.zh: 手册传统将克里特记为多宫室中心格局（克诺索斯、费斯托斯、马利亚、扎克罗斯等），而非单一都城叙事即可穷尽。
statement.en: Handbooks treat Crete as a multi-palace landscape (Knossos, Phaistos, Malia, Zakros, etc.), not exhausted by a single-capital narrative.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-27; bibliographic details verified via WebSearch/catalogs; no invented page numbers/coordinates/forged images.
